name: Bo hap gung
summary: The provincial tourism center names Bò hấp gừng as one plate made from Trảng Bàng young beef. It does not describe the cut, the fire, or the sauce. The beef itself is the animal of about 5 to 6 months described on the bò tơ article. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Trảng Bàng, from the same young-beef article as the rice-paper roll.
howToEat: The center lists this as steamed with ginger. The rest of the plate was not printed. Check on arrival.
The hour is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The beef rooms the article names are in phường Trảng Bàng, phường An Tịnh, and along Quốc lộ 22. It does not give this plate its own address.
